answer: Home pickup isn't available in Texas, so you'd need to book an appraisal appointment at a store instead. Before then, confirm your leasing company allows third-party buyouts, and either get a dealer payoff quote from them or sign the lease buyout authorization (form NW-LSE-1) so we can request it for you. Bring that dealer payoff quote, a physical photo ID for every owner on the title (mobile IDs are only accepted in Virginia), the current registration, all keys and remotes, the title if you have it, and the odometer disclosure statement (form NW-ODO-2). Plan for the appointment to take about an hour.
